What We Do

Full-Service Demolition
& Excavation

01
New on the Site

Demolition

Structure demolition and teardown with full site cleanup — done safely, done right, and hauled away.

02

Grading & Pad Construction

Precision grading and engineered pad builds for homes, shops, equipment storage and agricultural structures.

03

Road & Driveway Work

New road construction and driveway rehabilitation — graded, crowned and built to handle Alberta weather and heavy traffic.

04

Trenching & Excavation

Accurate trenching for water, gas, electrical and drainage — plus excavation for foundations, basements and site development.

05

Oilfield Services

Site preparation, access road construction, lease maintenance and support services for oilfield operations.

06

Fencing & Livestock

Wire fencing for livestock containment and property lines, plus livestock waterer installation for agricultural operations.

07

Snow Removal

Commercial and industrial snow removal for yards, access roads and work sites. Dependable service when conditions demand it.

08

Reclamation

Land reclamation following construction, oilfield or agricultural disturbance — restoring sites to a stable, productive condition.

09

Erosion Control

Practical erosion control for slopes, disturbed land and drainage channels that protects soil and water quality.

10

Contract Hauling

Reliable contract hauling for dirt, gravel, aggregate and other materials — where you need it, when you need it.

Who We Are

Owner-Operated.
Reputation-Driven.

Straight Line Excavating was founded by Cody Hall and Rick Morand — two people with deep roots in Alberta’s construction and oilfield industries, who believe good work speaks for itself.

As an owner-operated company, our reputation is tied directly to every project we take on. You deal with us directly — from the first site assessment through to final cleanup — whether it’s a small residential job or a large-scale commercial or oilfield contract.
